subject: general
question: The ________ is the constitutional head of Executive of the Indian Union.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.

__
 
• **The President is the constitutional head of the Union**__. President is the **head of the State** while **Prime Minister is the head of the government.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pursuant to Article 79** of the Constitution of India, the Assembly of the Parliament of the Union shall be composed of the President and two Houses known as the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) and the House of People (Lok Sabha).
 
• Article 74 (1) of the Constitution specifies that a Council of Ministers shall be constituted with the Prime Minister as its head of assistance and shall advise the President, who shall exercise his or her duties in accordance with the advice of the Prime Minister.
 
• The true executive power is conferred on the Council of Ministers,** chaired by the Prime Minister**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The President of India**, formally the President of the Republic of India is the ceremonial head of state of India and commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The Republic is ruled by the Constitution of India adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949 and entered into effect on 26 January 1950.
 
• The Constitution provides for a legislative system of government that is territorial in nature with some unitary elements.
